capabilities: Organize notes into folders using per-vault rules
Manually file notes, selections, or folders to chosen destinations
Route notes to destinations with AI suggestions after previewing
Detect exact and similar duplicate notes
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; managed OpenRouter key has a $1 lifetime limit and AI runs consume credits.
problem: Obsidian leaves note filing to the user, so keeping a growing vault sorted into folders takes repeated manual moves.

relations.evidence: Configure your own OpenAI key through Obsidian Secret Storage, or choose OpenRouter in settings.
OpenRouter is the default provider for new installations.
AI planning uses a connected Constance account and organize-run credits

summary: Folder organizer that sorts notes into destinations using per-vault rules, manual filing, optional AI routing, previews and undo.
